The '''capitol building''' was a structure located in [[Harazod]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gerrard V]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Gerrard V Rebels|local rebels]] commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Camon Udeon]] retreated to the capitol building after their [[Uprising on Gerrard V|attempt]] to capture and hold Harazod was countered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jion Trynn]]. Udeon was offered terms of surrender; the rebel refused, and Trynn bombarded the urban center of Harazod.<ref name="GNN3" />
